task.title: Install HP Driver on Windows 11
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to install the HP driver on a Windows 11 system.

prereq.p: Ensure that you have administrative privileges on the Windows 11 system.

step.cmd: Download the HP driver from the official website.
Double-click the downloaded driver file to start the installation.
Follow the on-screen instructions to proceed with the installation.
When the User Account Control (UAC) dialog appears, click Yes to allow the installation to proceed.
step.result: The installation continues after you confirm the UAC prompt.

step.cmd: Complete the installation by following the remaining on-screen instructions.
